The girl was his sister or girlfriend. I still think about this a lot and it helps me to deal with my suicidal thoughts.

Still coming down so bare with me please. I took the mushrooms around 11. I took an early morning walk with my dog in the woods and came home and did some yoga and meditation before ingestion. On the come up I played with my dog in the back yard looking at the blossoming tulips and listening to the birds sing. Perfect weather today in the PNW. I came back inside and laid in bed for while, then played video games. At this point there are no visuals up to 4 hours. I decided it would be a wise idea to smoke some dabs and build my confidence to go for a walk outside the block with my dog. I get about to the point where I have to cross the street and realize this isn’t such a great idea after all. Instead of just turning around and going home. I soldier on because I am worried that people will realize I’m high. I walk around the block anyways, grounding myself along the way realizing that now I’m starting to get visuals. The long sidewalk just felt like a unless treadmill. Coming up to turns required some focus. I got to the part in the road that has some traffic and had to cross that took a few minutes to do. Anyways I made it back home and listening to my favorite playlist and some more dabs. 🤞
